task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the cream cheese block beside the bowl.
Reach the empty gripper over the table toward the cream cheese block beside the bowl.
Approach the open gripper down over the cream cheese block on the table.
Grasp the cream cheese block between the fingers while it rests on the table.
Grasp the cream cheese block from the table and lift it up toward the bowl.
Lift the cream cheese up off the table, away from the bowl.
Lower the cream cheese down into the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and raise the empty gripper.
Open the gripper and readjust above the bowl.
